animals.name: White-tailed Deer
animals.summary: Fawns are often found alone — this is normal. Does leave fawns hidden while foraging.
callRehabWhen: Fawn is crying continuously for more than a few hours
Fawn is visibly injured
Dead doe is found nearby
Fawn is following humans or dogs
animals.commonMistake: Picking up a curled, quiet fawn — they are 'hiding', not abandoned.

animals.name: Eastern Cottontail
animals.summary: Nests are often disturbed by lawn mowers. Mother visits briefly at dusk and dawn.
callRehabWhen: Kit is cold and unresponsive
Visible injury
Cat or dog has handled it (saliva is toxic to rabbits)
Eyes still closed and nest is destroyed
animals.commonMistake: Handling a nest kit — cottontails panic-die easily and rarely survive human-raised attempts.

animals.name: Canada Goose
animals.summary: Goslings look small and vulnerable but usually have a parent close by.
callRehabWhen: Gosling is alone for hours with no adults present
Bird has an obvious wing or leg injury
Bird covered in oil or chemical
animals.commonMistake: Taking goslings because they seemed 'unattended' — parents are nearby.

animals.name: Raccoon
animals.summary: Raccoons are a rabies vector species. Never handle with bare hands.
callRehabWhen: Kit is wandering alone, crying
Adult is acting disoriented in daylight
Animal has a visible injury
animals.commonMistake: Hand-raising kit raccoons at home — illegal in Michigan without a permit and dangerous.

animals.name: Mallard Duck
animals.summary: Ducklings separated from their mother are at immediate risk. Act quickly.
callRehabWhen: Ducklings are separated from mother with no adult visible
Ducklings are inside a structure (basement, storm drain)
Bird has obvious injury
animals.commonMistake: Feeding bread — bread is harmful to waterfowl and encourages dependency.

animals.name: Songbirds
animals.summary: Fledglings (hopping, short-winged birds on the ground) are not injured — they are learning to fly.
callRehabWhen: Bird is visibly injured (drooping wing, leg injury)
Bird has been in a cat's mouth
True nestling (no feathers, or pin feathers only) fell from nest
animals.commonMistake: Picking up fledglings — they SHOULD be on the ground. Parents are watching.

animals.name: Virginia Opossum
animals.summary: Opossums are North America's only marsupial. Joeys smaller than a dollar bill need immediate care.
callRehabWhen: Opossum is smaller than 7–8 inches body length (not tail)
Visible injury
Found clinging to a dead mother
animals.commonMistake: Playing dead is normal — 'playing opossum' is a real, involuntary response.
